findings.message: stomp reaches only -15.5 LUFS of its -14 target: it's too peaky to get louder without more than 3 dB of limiting. Give it more body (longer decay/sustain, less transient) or a quieter category

before.source:
name: stomp
description: "Landing on an enemy: a squashy square bounce down an octave over a short kick thud, with a soft pop."
category: sfx
status: draft
style_version: 1
tags: [player, enemy]
duration: 0.32
layers:
  - id: squash                # the bounce: a fat square dropping an octave
    osc: pulse
    duty: 0.5
    start: 0.038              # wait for the pop... (lint: W005)
    pitch: [[0, A4], [0.12, A3]]
    slide: true
    env: [0.001, 0.08, 0.4, 0.08]
    length: 0.12
    gain: -6
  - id: thud
    drum: kick
    start: 0.038
    tune: 60
    decay: 0.18
    punch: 12
    gain: -4
  - id: pop
    osc: noise
    start: 0.038
    filter: { type: bp, cutoff: 1800, resonance: 0.3 }
    env: [0.001, 0.03, 0.0, 0.02]
    gain: -14

sound.name: stomp
sound.description: Landing on an enemy: a squashy square bounce down an octave over a short kick thud, with a soft pop.

next.say: They'll play all the time. Can they vary a bit?
